name: lol-traditional-classic-builder
description: 英雄联盟怀旧服攻略介绍：60 位英雄、242 套 S3 考据玩法，以及现代技能搭配经典地图、装备与强化符文的怀旧海斗攻略。

scripts.data:update: npm run classic:catalog:update && node scripts/sync-classic-data.mjs && npm run mayhem:update && npm run assets:update
scripts.data:check: npm run classic:catalog:check && node scripts/sync-classic-data.mjs --check && npm run mayhem:check && npm run assets:check
scripts.mayhem:update: node scripts/generate-classic-mayhem-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-opgg-mayhem-builds.mjs && node scripts/export-mayhem-runtime.mjs
scripts.mayhem:check: node scripts/generate-classic-mayhem-data.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-opgg-mayhem-builds.mjs --check && node scripts/export-mayhem-runtime.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run assets:check && node --test tests/champion-search.test.mjs tests/classic-detail-data.test.mjs tests/classic-catalog-opgg.test.mjs tests/classic-mayhem-data.test.mjs tests/mayhem-runtime.test.mjs tests/opgg-mayhem-parser.test.mjs && npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
